newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian upper house to debate 1997 budget on Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: Russian upper house to debate 1997 budget on Feb 4.

text.p: Russia's upper house of parliament will debate the 1997 budget on February 4, not on February 12 as originally planned, Itar-Tass news agency quoted the chamber's chairman as saying on Wednesday.

Federation Council Chairman Yegor Stroyev said passing the budget was essential for Russia's regions, who are represented in the chamber, but the draft was weak and it took too little account of revenue needs.
The lower house of parliament approved the budget last Friday, handing the document over to the upper house for consideration. It must then be signed into law by President Boris Yeltsin.
The budget envisages a deficit of 3.5 percent of Gross Domestic Product, by Russian calculations, on revenues of 434.4 trillion roubles and expenditures of 529.8 trillion roubles.
The International Monetary Fund and other funding organisations see passage of the bill as an indication that Russia is controlling its economic planning.
